svg.text: CT-DOCK-001-C | Wire clamp and assembly fixture / r15
PROTOTYPE — geometry checked; clamp retention, dock holding and electrical release remain open
Wearable, PCB, key, seals and spring-contact seats unchanged.
The fixture controls assembly shape only. Free wires still require cycle tests.
Squeeze is not a friction, insulation-strain or lifetime calculation.
Factory pull target: 5N / 60s per wire; no physical result exists.
Position error and later slip share the same +/- 0.10mm budget.
Open: latch, internal J3 route, pack approval, firmware and physical power/RF/water/dust testing. No order release.
2026-10-26 | Units: mm | See dock.json, sources.json, checks.json, mesh-checks.json and README | Review only
